title: 第十一章 第一课 魔法平衡木第十二章 深夜夜谈的传说
lines: 第十一章第一课魔法平衡术
清晨的薄雾还未散尽，幻境学院的试炼场已被一层淡金色的光晕笼罩。不同于寻常教室的四壁合围，这里更像一片被魔法结界包裹的露天场地——地面是打磨光滑的黑曜石，边缘镶嵌着会随晨光流转的银纹，抬头能望见被切割成菱形的天空，云絮仿佛被无形的力量固定在格子里，缓慢漂移。
林澈站在试炼场入口，指尖无意识地摩挲着袖口。昨夜宿舍四人的谈话还萦绕在耳边，凯拍着胸脯说要在实战课上让所有人见识魔法国的烈焰，苏璃轻声担忧着古籍库失窃案的后续，月姬则望着窗外的月亮，突然冒出一句“平衡被打破时，镜子会先碎”。那时他只当是少女的呓语，此刻站在这里，却莫名觉得空气里浮动着一种微妙的张力，像绷到极致的弦。
“林澈？”
身后传来轻唤，他回头，看见苏璃提着裙摆快步走来，浅绿的学院制服上别着一枚银叶徽章——那是灵都国学子的标志。她怀里抱着一本皮质封面的书，封面上用藤蔓花纹缠绕着“自然共鸣”四个字。
“苏璃，”林澈点头，“你也被分到这个班了？”
“嗯，导师说‘秘境预备班’的第一课是魔法平衡术，所有入选的人都要来。”苏璃抬眼望向试炼场中央，那里已经站了不少人，各国学子的徽章在晨光下闪烁，“你看，凯在那边。”
不远处，凯正和两个魔法国的男生击掌，火红的短发像团燃烧的火焰，他似乎说了句什么，引得周围人一阵笑。而在更安静的角落，月姬独自站在一块反光的黑曜石旁，低头看着自己在石面上的倒影，指尖偶尔轻点，倒影便会泛起一圈涟漪。
“人差不多到齐了。”
一个低沉的声音自身后响起，林澈等人转身，看见一位身着深灰长袍的导师缓步走来。他的袍角绣着银色的天平图案，头发是罕见的灰白色，却丝毫不显苍老，尤其是那双眼睛，瞳孔像被打磨过的双色水晶，左半边呈浅蓝，右半边是深褐。
“我是你们的魔法平衡术导师，安格尔。”导师的声音不高，却清晰地传到每个人耳中，“在幻境学院，你们或许学过如何放大火焰的温度，如何加快藤蔓的生长，如何撕裂空间或扭曲镜像——但今天，我们学的是‘收’。”
安格尔抬手，掌心向上。刹那间，试炼场边缘的银纹亮起，四股不同的能量从四个方向涌来：东边升起一道火柱，西边凝结出冰墙，南边钻出缠结的藤蔓，北边卷起旋转的风刃。四种力量在场地中央碰撞，发出刺耳的嗡鸣，空气仿佛都在震颤。
凯下意识地绷紧了手臂，似乎想召唤火焰与之对抗；苏璃则蹙起眉，手指扣住了怀中的书。
“这是未经平衡的魔法。”安格尔的声音依旧平静，他双手合十，那双双色瞳孔微微收缩。奇迹般的，中央碰撞的四股力量像是被一只无形的手安抚，火柱收敛了灼热，冰墙融化成水流，藤蔓褪去尖刺，风刃化作微风。它们缠绕着盘旋上升，最终凝聚成一颗流转着四色光芒的光球，悬浮在半空，安静得像一颗宝石。
“哇……”人群里有人低呼。
安格尔松开手，光球缓缓散开，化作光点落入地面的黑曜石中，石面上的银纹随之亮了亮，又恢复原状。“魔法的本质是能量流动，如同河流。你们过去学的‘释放’，是拓宽河道；而‘平衡’，是让不同的河流交汇时，既不泛滥，也不枯竭。”
他目光扫过众人：“秘境探索中，最危险的从不是强大的守护兽，而是失控的能量场。不同属性的魔法碰撞，极可能引发空间崩塌——就像刚才，如果我不介入，这半个试炼场都会被炸成废墟。”
林澈心头一动。他想起入学那天，自己无意间触发的空间波动，当时若不是导师及时压制，恐怕真会闹出乱子。
“今天的课很简单。”安格尔指向试炼场中央突然升起的数十根石柱，石柱顶端是宽窄不一的平台，最宽的约有手臂长，最窄的仅能容下一只脚，“站上平衡台，用你们的魔法维持自身稳定，同时，化解我从四个方向释放的能量冲击。”
他顿了顿，补充道：“记住，不是对抗，是引导。谁能在最窄的平台上坚持一炷香，谁就算过关。”
第一个尝试的是个魔法国的男生，他跃到一根较宽的石柱上，握紧拳头低喝一声，周身燃起橙红色的火焰。几乎同时，东边的方向射来一道更强的火流，显然是安格尔释放的能量。
男生眼中闪过一丝得意，猛地将自身火焰推向火流——两股火焰碰撞的瞬间，爆发出刺眼的光芒，男生被震得从石柱上摔了下来，狼狈地滚到地上。
“蠢货。”凯低声骂了一句，却也皱起了眉。
安格尔走到那男生面前，摇了摇头：“火焰遇到火焰，不是相加，是失控。你该做的，是让自己的火焰像溪流汇入江河，而不是用石头去堵。”
接下来的尝试者接连失败。灵都国的女生想用藤蔓缠绕来固定身体，却被突然袭来的水流冲断了藤蔓；镜幻国的男生试图用镜像分担冲击，反而被镜像反射的能量震得头晕目眩。
“轮到我们了？”凯活动着手腕，跃跃欲试。他选了一根中等宽度的石柱，深吸一口气，没有急着释放火焰，而是闭上眼，似乎在感受什么。当安格尔的火流再次袭来时，凯猛地睁眼，周身燃起的火焰竟呈现出一种流动的状态，像一层薄薄的火纱，将外来的火流轻轻“裹”住，引导着从身体两侧滑过。
“不错。”安格尔眼中闪过一丝赞许，“但还不够。”他话音刚落，西边突然传来冰锥的攻击，火与冰的碰撞本应激烈，凯却迅速调整火焰的温度，让靠近冰锥的部分火焰减弱，形成一个缓冲带，冰锥在接触到他身前时便化作了水汽。

Chapter 11 Lesson 1: Magical Balance
The early morning mist has not yet cleared, and the training ground of Illusion Academy has been shrouded in a pale golden halo. Different from the four walls of an ordinary classroom, this place is more like an open-air field wrapped in a magic barrier - the ground is smooth polished obsidian, and the edges are inlaid with silver patterns that flow with the morning light. Looking up, you can see the sky cut into a diamond shape, and the clouds seem to be fixed in the grid by invisible forces, slowly drifting.
Lin Che stood at the entrance of the trial ground, her fingertips unconsciously rubbing her sleeves. The conversation between the four people in the dormitory last night was still lingering in their ears. Kai patted his chest and said that he would let everyone see the flames of the Magic Kingdom in the practical class. Su Li was quietly worried about the consequences of the theft of the ancient book library. Yue Ji looked at the moon outside the window and suddenly said, "When the balance is broken, the mirror will break first." At that time, he just thought it was a girl's gibbering. But now, standing here, he felt a subtle tension floating in the air, like a string stretched to the extreme.
"Lin Che?"
There was a soft call from behind. He turned around and saw Su Li walking quickly with her skirt in hand. There was a silver leaf badge pinned to the light green college uniform - that was the symbol of a student from Lingdu Kingdom. She held a leather-bound book in her arms, with the words "Natural Resonance" wrapped in a vine pattern on the cover.
"Su Li," Lin Che nodded, "Were you also assigned to this class?"
"Well, the instructor said that the first lesson of the 'Secret Realm Preparatory Class' is Magical Balance, and all those selected are required to come." Su Li raised her eyes and looked at the center of the trial field. There were already many people standing there, and the badges of students from various countries flashed in the morning light. "Look, Kai is over there."
Not far away, Kai was high-fiving two boys from the Magic Kingdom. His short fiery red hair was like a burning flame. He seemed to have said something, which made the people around him laugh. In a quieter corner, Yue Ji stood alone next to a piece of reflective obsidian, looking down at her reflection on the stone surface. With the occasional tap of her fingertips, a circle of ripples would appear in the reflection.
"Everyone is almost here."
A deep voice sounded behind her, and Lin Che and others turned around and saw a mentor wearing dark gray robes walking slowly towards them. The corners of his robe were embroidered with a silver scale pattern, and his hair was a rare gray-white color, but it did not look old at all, especially his eyes. The pupils were like polished two-color crystals, with the left half being light blue and the right half being dark brown.
"I am your magic balance instructor, Angel." The instructor's voice was low, but it reached everyone's ears clearly. "In Illusion Academy, you may have learned how to amplify the temperature of flames, how to speed up the growth of vines, how to tear apart space or distort mirror images - but today, we learned about 'harvest'."
Angel raised his hand, palm upward. In an instant, the silver pattern on the edge of the trial field lit up, and four different energies surged in from four directions: a pillar of fire rose from the east, an ice wall condensed from the west, tangled vines emerged from the south, and rotating wind blades rolled up from the north. The four forces collided in the center of the field, making a harsh buzz, and the air seemed to be vibrating.
Kai subconsciously tightened his arms, as if he wanted to summon flames to fight against it; Su Li frowned and clasped the book in her arms with her fingers.
"This is unbalanced magic." Angel's voice was still calm, he clasped his hands together, and his two-color pupils shrank slightly. Miraculously, the four forces colliding in the center seemed to be soothed by an invisible hand. The fire pillar restrained the scorching heat, the ice wall melted into water flow, the vines shed their spikes, and the wind blade turned into breeze. They entangled and spiraled upward, and finally condensed into a ball of light flowing with four-color light, suspended in mid-air, as quiet as a gem.
"Wow..." someone in the crowd whispered.
Angel let go of his hand, and the ball of light slowly dispersed, turning into light spots and falling into the obsidian on the ground. The silver patterns on the stone surface then brightened and returned to their original state. "The essence of magic is the flow of energy, just like a river. The 'release' you learned in the past is to widen the river channel; and the 'balance' is to prevent different rivers from flooding or drying up when they meet."
He glanced at everyone: "In the exploration of the secret realm, the most dangerous thing is never the powerful guardian beast, but the out-of-control energy field. The collision of magic with different attributes is very likely to cause the collapse of the space - just like just now, if I didn't intervene, this half of the trial ground would be blown into ruins."
Lin Che's heart moved. He recalled the spatial fluctuations he had inadvertently triggered on the day he entered school. If his instructor had not suppressed them in time, he might have caused trouble.
"Today's lesson is very simple." Angel pointed to dozens of stone pillars that suddenly rose in the center of the trial field. At the top of the stone pillars was a platform of varying widths. The widest one was about the length of an arm, and the narrowest one could only accommodate one foot. "Stand on the balance platform, use your magic to maintain your own stability, and at the same time, neutralize the energy impacts I release from four directions."
He paused and added: "Remember, it's not confrontation, it's guidance. Whoever can stick to a stick of incense on the narrowest platform will pass."
The first one to try was a boy from the Magic Kingdom. He jumped onto a wider stone pillar, clenched his fists and shouted low, and his whole body ignited with orange-red flames. Almost at the same time, a stronger stream of fire shot from the east, which was obviously the energy released by Angel.
A trace of pride flashed in the boy's eyes, and he pushed his own flame into the fire stream - the moment the two flames collided, a dazzling light erupted, and the boy was shocked and fell off the stone pillar, rolling to the ground in embarrassment.
"Idiot." Kai cursed in a low voice, but also frowned.
Angel walked up to the boy and shook his head: "When flames meet flames, they don't add up, they lose control. What you should do is to let your flames flow into the river like a stream, instead of blocking it with stones."
Subsequent attempts failed one after another. The girls from Lingdu Kingdom tried to wrap their bodies with vines, but the vines were broken by the sudden onslaught of water. The boys from Jinghuan Kingdom tried to use mirror images to share the impact, but were dizzy by the energy reflected by the mirror images.
"Is it our turn?" Kai moved his wrist, eager to give it a try. He chose a stone pillar of medium width, took a deep breath, and did not rush to release the flames. Instead, he closed his eyes as if he was feeling something. When Angel's fire stream struck again, Kai opened his eyes suddenly, and the flames ignited around his body actually showed a flowing state, like a thin layer of fire yarn, gently "wrapping" the external fire stream and guiding it to slide past both sides of his body.
"Not bad." A flash of approval flashed in Angel's eyes, "But it's not enough." As soon as he finished speaking, an attack from the ice cone suddenly came from the west. The collision between fire and ice should have been fierce, but Kai quickly adjusted the temperature of the flame to weaken the part of the flame close to the ice cone, forming a buffer zone. The ice cone turned into water vapor when it touched in front of him.
